finish.summary: Seven-cell honeycomb work surface built with 7 bases and 7 top covers; all 18 open outside edges capped and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Built seven-cell honeycomb work surface covered and capped as requested.

**Requirements:**

*   **Seven-cell honeycomb shape:** **met** — 7x full base pieces (piece:0,0,0;full center + q1,0 / q1,-1 / q0,-1 / q-1,0 / q-1,1 / q0,1)
*   **Covered on top:** **met** — 7 top covers (cover: q0,0 / q1,0 / q1,-1 / q0,-1 / q-1,0 / q-1,1 / q0,1 ;top)
*   **Every open outside edge finished with caps:** **met** — 18 end caps via capOpenFaces around perimeter (3 per outer cell × 6 cells). Joints locked with joint bolts.

**Verification:** check_build ok, meshClash clear, no issues. 53 parts, ~2728g, 4010 min print estimate.

**Outcome:** built
